note: HARNESS config. Scores the harness axis and nothing else: one model, one task, every harness, into data/raw.harness.json and its own README block. A real harness spends ~5x the tokens of mini-loop, so a full 5-task run of it costs 630k tokens -- more than the free tier's 200k/day allowance, which is why it lives here instead of in config.json. Run it on one task (see .github/workflows/bench.yml, mode=harness); add tasks as the budget allows.

variants.vanilla: You are an expert Python developer. Solve the task exactly as specified.
variants.minimal: Write the least Python that fully satisfies the spec. Standard library only. No classes, no abstractions, no comments beyond the spec, no error handling beyond what the spec requires. Output only the code.
